metadata.description: Multi-provider marketplace for the ACP Harness: Claude skill plugins, GitHub-sourced ACP agents, and generic ACP agent templates.

plugins.name: acp-harness-skills
plugins.description: Curated Agent Skills for running ACP agents, curating this marketplace, and building MCP Apps (ext-apps) UIs. Bundles the ACP Harness MCP server.

plugins.name: gemini-cli-acp
plugins.description: Gemini CLI as an ACP agent (native --experimental-acp). Installed from GitHub.

plugins.name: claude-code-acp
plugins.description: Claude Code exposed over ACP via the claude-code-acp adapter. Installed from GitHub.

plugins.name: generic-acp-agent
plugins.description: A provider-agnostic ACP agent template. Copy it and point the launch descriptor at any ACP-compliant agent binary.
